title: 第5章神仙打架

content_zh:
龙飞兴奋起来，“找个强一点的妖兽，这样爆出来的东西肯定更强。”
狂暴系统。
狂暴神器宝物，想到这些龙飞心里就有种按捺不住的冲动，恨不得立刻就杀一头妖兽给爆掉。
他并没有这样做。
根据他多年的游戏经验，你猎杀的怪物等级越高，爆出来的东西就越好，这一次他要找个二级妖兽。
“对，也该试一试二级妖兽了。”龙飞心里打定主意，随后小心翼翼的前行。
走了大概半个时辰，龙飞感觉有点不对劲，因为周围没有发现任何妖兽，就连野兽都没有一只。
这一片静的有些恐怖。
加上阴森森的丛林，天色昏暗，更加给人一种恐怖气氛。
忽然间。
一阵奇异的香味飘散出来，龙飞心神一紧，立刻暗道：“天地灵果？”
他在火璃山脉都块两个月了，从来没有闻到过如此奇异的香味，他敢用二十年的处男之身保证，绝对不是女人用的香水。
在这凶险无比的山脉中散发出这种香味的只有一种可能，天地孕育而成的灵果。
这种天地灵果一定会有神兽守护。
“神兽！”
“要是能用狂暴能量值爆掉的话，那一定……爽歪歪了。”龙飞激动起来，不过风险和回报永远是成正比的。
回报越丰厚，风险就越大。
龙飞慢慢的靠近，一处灌木丛中停了下来，用树叶汁水洒满全身，在脸上涂上污泥，背上插在几株树枝，趴在地上完全看不出是一个人。做完这一切，龙飞没有动，他看着远处山谷的深洞中，时不时闪出红光，“绝对是天地灵果孕育的地方，而且恐怕快要成熟了。”
他在等待。
因为他还没有看到守护神兽。

他相信这种天地灵果诞生，一定会有别的妖兽赶来争夺。
他要当渔翁。
也只能当渔翁，他这种修为实力进去就是找死。
一天过去。
守护神兽还是没有出现。
争夺者也没有出现，这让龙飞有些坐不住了。
山谷洞中的红光更加的猛烈，一环扣着一环，整个山谷都充满奇异的香味，轻轻的闻一点都能让人精神大振。
第二天过去。
还是一样，没有任何守护神兽出现。
龙飞心中暗道：“不会没有神兽发现吧？还是谁守护神兽在山洞里面？”
内心距离的挣扎，纠结，就好像两个人在打架一样，最终理智战胜了，他还是忍住，趴在原地不动。
第三天。
天上乌云滚滚，不断的有雷鸣轰下，雷云在山谷上空纹丝不动。
一道闪电劈了下来，一条头上长着两只犄角的蛇冲出云层，腾空一动，直接落在山洞口。
“我靠，蛟龙！”
龙飞脸色一惊，“这尼玛绝逼是九级巅峰妖兽，甚至可以称得上是神兽，不来不知道，一来差点吓死我了。”
有四爪，并且头上长着犄角，身体如蛇，还没有完全进化，再进化一步的话，那就是龙了！
它绝对是想要山洞中的天地灵果冲破桎梏，化蛟为龙。
在那条蛟龙落下的瞬间。
地动山摇，山洞中闪出一道白光，白光落地，一头全身雪白的白狼站在洞口，身上散发着点点灵光，就好像游戏中发光武器一样，要知道这些都是神品武器啊。

蛟龙和白狼对视着。
天空中不断发出震耳欲聋的雷鸣声，就好像它们两个在用意念交战一样。
龙飞身体趴的更低，心中无比的冷静，投过系统看去，发现它们身上散发着金光闪闪的光芒，“BOSS！”
游戏中只有BOSS才会散发金光。
“咕咚！”
龙飞干咽了一口气，兴奋祈祷道：“开打啊，快开打啊，快点开打啊。”
等不急了。
可能是龙飞祈祷起了作用，蛟龙突然出击，一道水系攻击释放出去，尾巴一卷，猛地一扇。
一道巨大的风刃成半月形状横空斩下。
白狼并不惧怕，他的身上多处一道护盾，护盾将它全身包裹住，在这之后，它突然一跃，飞至半空，张开血盆大口朝蛟龙头上咬去。
“砰，砰，砰……”
“轰，轰，轰……”
两只巅峰妖兽打的不可开交，可谓是地动山摇，方圆数千公里内所有的妖兽都在朝外奔跑出去，生怕被卷入其中。
对龙飞而言，完全就是神仙打架。
那力量轻微一丁点就能将他碾碎成粉末。
从白天打到黑夜，从黑夜打到天亮，足足一天一夜都在不停的厮杀。
蛟龙身上的鳞片掉落，到处都是抓痕。白狼身上鲜血淋漓，到处都是伤口，这一天一夜的战斗谁也没有讨到好处。

content_en:
Long Fei became excited, "Find a stronger monster, the thing that will explode will definitely be stronger."
Rage system.
Thinking of these violent artifacts and treasures, Long Fei felt an uncontrollable impulse in his heart, wishing he could kill a monster immediately and explode it.
He didn't do this.
According to his many years of game experience, the higher the level of the monster you hunt, the better the things that will explode. This time he is looking for a second-level monster.
"Yes, it's time to give the second-level monster a try." Long Fei made up his mind and then moved forward cautiously.
After walking for about half an hour, Long Fei felt something was wrong, because he didn't find any monsters around, not even a wild beast.
This place was eerily quiet.
Coupled with the gloomy jungle and the dark sky, it gives people an even more terrifying atmosphere.
suddenly.
A strange fragrance wafted out, Long Fei's mind tightened, and he immediately said to himself: "Heaven and Earth Spirit Fruit?"
He has been in the Huoli Mountains for two months, and he has never smelled such a strange fragrance. He can guarantee with his twenty years of virginity that it is definitely not a perfume for women.
There is only one possibility for this kind of fragrance to be emitted in this extremely dangerous mountain range, which is the spiritual fruit bred by heaven and earth.
This kind of heaven and earth spirit fruit will definitely be protected by divine beasts.
"Mythical beast!"
"If it can explode with violent energy, it will be... so cool." Long Fei became excited, but risks and rewards are always directly proportional.
The greater the reward, the greater the risk.
Long Fei slowly approached and stopped in a bush. He sprinkled leaf juice all over his body, smeared mud on his face, and stuck several branches on his back. He lay on the ground and could not tell that he was alone. After doing all this, Long Fei did not move. He looked at the deep cave in the valley in the distance, and red light flashed from time to time. "It is definitely the place where the Heaven and Earth Spirit Fruit is bred, and it is probably about to mature."
He is waiting.
Because he hasn't seen the guardian beast yet.
He believed that when this kind of heaven and earth spirit fruit was born, other monsters would definitely come to compete for it.
He wants to be a fisherman.
He can only be a fisherman. With his cultivation level, he is seeking death.
One day passed.
The guardian beast still didn't appear.
The contender didn't show up either, which made Long Fei a little unable to sit still.
The red light in the valley cave is even more intense, linking one link after another, and the entire valley is filled with a strange fragrance. A gentle smell can make people feel refreshed.
The next day passed.
Still the same, no guardian beast appeared.
Long Fei thought to himself: "Isn't it possible that no divine beast discovered it? Or who protects the divine beast in the cave?"
The struggle and entanglement of inner distance was like two people fighting. In the end, reason won, and he still endured it and lay still.
The third day.
Dark clouds were rolling in the sky, and thunder continued to rumble down. The thunderclouds remained motionless over the valley.
A bolt of lightning struck down, and a snake with two horns on its head rushed out of the clouds, flew into the air, and landed directly at the entrance of the cave.
"Damn it, Jiaolong!"
Long Fei's face was startled, "This is definitely a ninth-level peak monster. It can even be called a divine beast. I wouldn't have known it until I came here. It almost scared me to death."
It has four claws, horns on its head, and a body like a snake. It has not yet fully evolved. If it evolves one more step, it will become a dragon!
It definitely wants the heaven and earth spiritual fruits in the cave to break through the shackles and turn into dragons.
At that moment when the dragon fell.
The earth shook and the mountains shook. A white light flashed out in the cave. The white light fell to the ground. A snow-white white wolf stood at the entrance of the cave. It was emitting little auras, just like the luminous weapons in the game. You must know that these are divine weapons.
The dragon and the white wolf looked at each other.
Deafening thunder continued to sound in the sky, as if the two of them were at war with their minds.
Long Fei lay lower, his heart extremely calm. He looked over the systems and found that they were exudingThe golden light flashed, "BOSS!"
Only the BOSS in the game emits golden light.
"Gudong!"
Long Fei took a dry breath and prayed excitedly: "Start the fight, start the fight quickly, start the fight quickly."
There's no time to wait.
Perhaps Long Fei's prayer had an effect, the dragon suddenly attacked, released a water attack, curled its tail, and slapped fiercely.
A huge wind blade cut across the sky in the shape of a half moon.
The white wolf was not afraid. There were multiple shields on his body, and the shields covered his whole body. After that, he suddenly jumped, flew into the air, opened his bloody mouth and bit the dragon's head.
"Bang, bang, bang..."
"Boom, boom, boom..."
The two peak monsters were fighting fiercely, and it could be said that the earth was shaking. All the monsters within thousands of kilometers were running away, for fear of being involved.
To Long Fei, it was a fight between gods and gods.
The slightest bit of power could crush him into powder.
Fighting from day to night, from night to dawn, it was a full day and night of non-stop fighting.
The scales on the dragon's body fell off and there were scratches everywhere. White Wolf's body was dripping with blood and there were wounds everywhere. No one benefited from this day and night of fighting.
